fix#36: `tar xzf ... --strip-components=3 podman-linux-amd64/usr/local/bin` extracted only the usr/local/bin subtree; `podman` was then not found because PATH pointed at the prefix root. fix#37: with .../podman/bin on PATH, `podman version 6.1.2`; `podman info` failed with `Error: could not find a working conmon binary (configured options: [/usr/libexec/podman/conmon /usr/local/libexec/podman/conmon /usr/local/lib/podman/conmon ...]: invalid argument)`.
The earlier statement that the tarball omits conmon is not supported: the searched paths include /usr/local/lib/podman/conmon, and the archive's usr/local/lib subtree was never listed or extracted.

Only after `podman info` works can the filesystem and network fixtures run in a container.
